PER COURT :
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the applicants and the learned Counsel for the respondent.
2. Respondents have oppose the application on the ground that there was 4 days delay in lodging the FIR.

4. Considering the matter and grounds of objections,
this Court is of the view that the application deserves to be allowed.

Hence the order :
 ORDER a) The application is allowed.
